title: Chip It Land It Roll It (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 130bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl mandolin
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, chipping is just a long putt with loft
Land it on the green, let it roll like a putt soft
Pick the spot, pick the club, trust the bounce

[Verse 1]
Ball back of center two inches, hands ahead three
Weight seventy thirty lead side, son, thats the key
Narrow stance, feet flared open ten degrees
Grip down to the steel, son, choke up please

[Pre-Chorus]
No wrist hinge, no flip, no scoop
Shoulder rock chip, like a putting loop
Land the ball on the green third of the way
Let it roll the rest, two thirds at play

[Chorus]
Chip it land it roll it, son
One third air, two thirds run
Land spot first, then the roll out
Thats how chipping wins the bout

[Verse 2]
Nine iron chip rolls four to one in the air
Pitching wedge two to one, more carry there
Sand wedge one to one, equal carry and roll
Choose the club for the lie, son, thats the soul

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, the chip is the get out of jail card
Missed the green, dont press, dont play hard
Land it soft, let it roll, two putts at worst
Up and down sixty percent, dont be cursed

[Chorus]
Chip it land it roll it, son
One third air, two thirds run
Land spot first, then the roll out
Thats how chipping wins the bout

[Outro]
Land spot, roll out
One third, two thirds, no doubt
Nine iron, wedge, pick your tool
Thats my boy, thats the rule
